review: Glossary and form mechanics reviewed; nonmechanical back matter classified. Full index-to-inventory cross-reference audit remains open.

entries.acceptance: The glossary includes injury equal to half capacity in its major-wound definition; B420 specifies strictly greater than half. Record a documented precedence policy and test the exact-half boundary before completeness. Do not silently treat the glossary as identical.
A skill prerequisite requires at least one invested point; a default score alone is insufficient. Reconcile ability-specific exceptions and retain the original investment identity.

Time planning uses 168 hours per week. Baseline sleep is 56 hours with seven-hour weekly adjustments per sleep-trait level; ordinary unspecified employment assumes 40 hours. These planning defaults do not override actual job or sleep rules.

Daily interaction in a foreign culture permits four hours toward both the local language and cultural familiarity. Track the shared eligible interval and distinct permitted credits; do not spend eight additional clock hours.
One quarter of qualifying work time becomes study credit, optionally divided between relevant skills. Splitting allocations must not multiply the total earned credit.
Two hours self-study, one hour education or half an hour intensive training produce one effective hour. Keep exceptional magical/mechanical instruction credits separate and prevent double conversion.

Campaign configuration must expose allowed ancestry, languages, cultures, initial wealth/standing/technology ranges, point and negative-cost limits, required/forbidden traits, ability access, background costs, legal restrictions and optional rule selections. These fields connect to actual validation; a descriptive form alone is insufficient.

World configuration includes local exceptions to technology and control levels, multiple worlds, time rate, magical conditions and restricted spells/power families. Use location-specific contexts rather than changing one global setting on every actor.

Author-facing character reports distinguish base/current health, movement, defenses, armor by body region, reaction modifiers, required checks and special abilities. Derive values from shared state without creating duplicate mutable balances or reproducing the source form.

exclusions.reason: Glossary prose and aliases are not reproduced. Mechanical definitions refer to owning chapters; the major-wound boundary discrepancy and invested-prerequisite reminder are separately retained. Cross-reference audit remains open.
Supplement listings and promotional material are outside the supplied-reference mechanical conversion.
Form layouts, named sample character and illustrative equipment loadout are excluded. Configuration fields and time-accounting mechanics are retained as original requirements.

Index is navigation rather than additional executable rules. It remains useful for the final heading and cross-reference completeness audit; this classification does not certify all referenced entries are inventoried.
